'''Bahmat steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]] that could be paired in a meal with [[feelo egg]]s. While [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Slashtown]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]], the [[Zelosian]] [[Celot Ratua Dil]] fantasized about having an enjoyable meal of bahmat steak and feelo [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] instead of eating nearly nothing on the penal colony.<ref name="Death Star" />
